evo.note: Reward of quest_arron_ritual (unlocked by holding the Dragon Heart).

evo.note: Prelude only: no stat change by itself; the Kind path fires on his next completed quest.

evo.name: Supra Armor

evo.name: Reformed
evo.note: Adds a follow-up audience a few cycles later.

evo.name: Repaid
evo.note: Debt paid back; keeps her normal behaviour.

evo.name: Mage Formation
evo.note: Permanent +8 MAGIC once the magic-degree quest succeeds (script default).

evo.name: Dragon Heart Eaten
evo.note: Permanent stat bonus once the dragon heart is consumed.

evo.name: Destroyed by Kingslayer
evo.note: The Kingslayer ultimatum kills her: deaths_count is pushed past the HIGH corruption threshold, applying the high-corruption stat shift (script defaults).
